alt: A row of values with a window of the last k indices marked, next to a deque of indices whose values fall from front to back. A new index removes smaller or equal entries from the back before joining, an index older than the window leaves the front, and the front of the deque is always the maximum of the current window.

steps.caption: Index 0 holds 3 and joins the back of the deque.
Index 1 holds 1 and joins the back of the deque. The back entry is larger than 1, so nothing leaves the back.

Index 2 holds 4, at least as large as the back entries for indices 0 and 1. Those indices are older and no larger, so they can never be a window's maximum again and leave the back. Index 2 joins the deque.
The window holds indices 0 to 2. The front of the deque is index 2, so the window's maximum is 4.
Index 3 holds 1 and joins the back of the deque. The back entry is larger than 1, so nothing leaves the back.
The window holds indices 1 to 3. The front of the deque is index 2, so the window's maximum is 4.

Index 4 holds 9, at least as large as the back entries for indices 2 and 3. Those indices are older and no larger, so they can never be a window's maximum again and leave the back. Index 4 joins the deque.
The window holds indices 2 to 4. The front of the deque is index 4, so the window's maximum is 9.
Index 5 holds 2 and joins the back of the deque. The back entry is larger than 2, so nothing leaves the back.
The window holds indices 3 to 5. The front of the deque is index 4, so the window's maximum is 9.
Index 6 holds 1 and joins the back of the deque. The back entry is larger than 1, so nothing leaves the back.
The window holds indices 4 to 6. The front of the deque is index 4, so the window's maximum is 9.
The window is now indices 5 to 7. Index 4 is older than that, so it leaves the front of the deque.

Index 7 holds 6, at least as large as the back entries for indices 5 and 6. Those indices are older and no larger, so they can never be a window's maximum again and leave the back. Index 7 joins the deque.
The window holds indices 5 to 7. The front of the deque is index 7, so the window's maximum is 6.
The last window is done. The maximums, in order, are 4 4 9 9 9 6.
